description_en: Queries the metadata of a CMK, such as the key state, usage, and rotation configuration
name: DescribeKey

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CMK. The ID must be globally unique.

You can also set this parameter to an alias that is bound to the CMK. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68522.html
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`。
parameters.name: key_id

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the CMK

AutomaticRotation.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic key rotation is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled

Disabled

Suspended

For more information, see [Automatic key rotation]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134270.html）.

Only symmetric CMKs support automatic key rotation
AutomaticRotation.description_zh:
是否开启自动轮转，取值：

Enabled：开启自动轮转。
Disabled：关闭自动轮转。
Suspended：暂停执行自动轮转。  

更多信息，请参见[自动轮转密钥]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134270.html）。

仅对称密钥支持自动轮转

CreationDate.description_en: The time when the CMK was created. The time is displayed in UTC

Creator.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the CMK

DKMSInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated KMS instance

DeleteDate.description_en:
The time at which the CMK is scheduled for deletion. The time is displayed in UTC.

For more information, see [ScheduleKeyDeletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44196.html）.

This parameter is returned only when the value of the KeyState parameter is PendingDeletion
DeleteDate.description_zh:
CMK的预计删除时间（UTC）。  
更多信息，请参见[ScheduleKeyDeletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44196.html）。  

当KeyState取值为PendingDeletion时，返回该参数

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled

Disabled
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否开启删除保护，取值： 

Enabled：开启删除保护。
Disabled：关闭删除保护

DeletionProtectionDescription.example: The CMK is being used by XXX. Deletion protection is set.

KeyId.description_en: The ID of the CMK. The ID must be globally unique
KeyId.description_zh: 密钥ID。如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是密钥别名、密钥ARN，在响应中也会返回密钥ID

KeyState.description_en:
The status of the CMK.

For more information, see [Impact of CMK status on API operations]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44211.html）
KeyState.description_zh:
CMK的状态。  
更多信息，请参见[用户主密钥的状态对API调用的影响]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44211.html）

LastRotationDate.description_en: The time when the last rotation was performed. The time is displayed in UTC. For a new CMK, the value of this parameter is the time when the initial version of the CMK was generated
LastRotationDate.description_zh: 最近一次轮转的时间（UTC）。如果是新创建的密钥，则为初始密钥版本生成时间

MaterialExpireTime.description_en: The time when the key material expires. The time is displayed in UTC. If this parameter value is empty, the key material does not expire
MaterialExpireTime.description_zh: 密钥材料的过期时间（UTC）。当该值为空时，表示密钥材料不会过期

NextRotationDate.description_en:
The time when the next rotation will be performed.

This parameter is returned only when the value of the AutomaticRotation parameter is Enabled or Suspended
NextRotationDate.description_zh:
下一次轮转的时间。  

当AutomaticRotation取值为Enabled或Suspended时，返回该参数。

Origin.description_en: The source of the key material for the CMK

PrimaryKeyVersion.description_en: The ID of the current primary key version for the symmetric CMK
PrimaryKeyVersion.description_zh: 对称类型CMK当前的主版本标识符

ProtectionLevel.description_en: The protection level of the CMK

RotationInterval.description_en:
The interval for automatic key rotation.

Unit: seconds.

For example, if the value is 604800s, automatic key rotation is performed at a 7-day interval.

This parameter is returned only when the value of the AutomaticRotation parameter is Enabled or Suspended
RotationInterval.description_zh:
密钥自动轮转的周期。  
单位：s。  
例如：7天的轮转周期为604800s。  

当AutomaticRotation取值为Enabled或Suspended时，返回该参数。

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
